blurb: Guests can enjoy self-guided paddle trips of varying lengths on the Clyde River, with shuttle service upstream and boat rental included. Rentals include canoes, kayaks, and paddleboards with paddles and life jackets. Group outings and delivery services to local lakes and campgrounds are also available.
